load_yaml_config: load a YAML configuration file with recursive include support using OmegaConf and PathManager
merge_config_with_dotlist: merge command-line dotlist options into an OmegaConf DictConfig with nested field and array index support
build_configuration: build a full MMF configuration by merging defaults, model, dataset, user config, and CLI overrides
get_zoo_config: retrieve version and resources for a dataset or model from the MMF zoo YAML configuration file
resolve_cache_dir: resolve the MMF cache directory path from environment variables or fall back to the torch home directory
